name: Toyokoro (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Toyokoro town emblem in white: a ring enclosing a stylised character of horizontal bars.
history: Municipal flag of Toyokoro, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 November 1950.

features.role: Toyokoro town emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised character of horizontal bars
